name: Rust Generic
author: grandpaacademy
description: A generic Rust egg for building and running Rust applications. Supports git clone, cargo build, and custom release/debug builds.
startup: if [[ -d .git ]] && [[ {{AUTO_UPDATE}} == "1" ]]; then git pull; fi; if [ "${RELEASE_BUILD}" == "1" ]; then echo "Building in release mode..."; cargo build --release ${CARGO_ARGS}; BIN=target/release/${BIN_NAME}; else echo "Building in debug mode..."; cargo build ${CARGO_ARGS}; BIN=target/debug/${BIN_NAME}; fi; if [ -f "/home/container/${BIN}" ]; then exec /home/container/${BIN} ${APP_ARGS}; else echo "Binary not found at ${BIN}"; exit 1; fi

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Rust App Installation Script
apt update
apt install -y git curl jq file unzip pkg-config libssl-dev
mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

if [ "${USER_UPLOAD}" == "true" ] || [ "${USER_UPLOAD}" == "1" ]; then
    echo -e "assuming user knows what they are doing have a good day."
    exit 0
fi

if [[ ${GIT_ADDRESS} != *.git ]]; then
    GIT_ADDRESS=${GIT_ADDRESS}.git
fi

if [ -z "${USERNAME}" ] && [ -z "${ACCESS_TOKEN}" ]; then
    echo -e "using anon api call"
else
    GIT_ADDRESS="https://${USERNAME}:${ACCESS_TOKEN}@$(echo -e ${GIT_ADDRESS} | cut -d/ -f3-)"
fi

if [ "$(ls -A /mnt/server)" ]; then
    echo -e "/mnt/server directory is not empty."
    if [ -d .git ]; then
        if [ -f .git/config ]; then
            ORIGIN=$(git config --get remote.origin.url)
        else
            exit 10
        fi
    fi
    if [ "${ORIGIN}" == "${GIT_ADDRESS}" ]; then
        git pull
    fi
else
    if [ -z ${BRANCH} ]; then
        git clone ${GIT_ADDRESS} .
    else
        git clone --single-branch --branch ${BRANCH} ${GIT_ADDRESS} .
    fi
fi

echo -e "install complete"
exit 0

variables.name: Git Repo Address
variables.description: Git repo to clone. I.E. https://github.com/user/repo

variables.name: Git Branch
variables.description: What branch to pull from github. Default is blank to pull the repo default branch.

variables.name: User Uploaded Files
variables.description: Skip all the install stuff if you are letting a user upload files. 0 = false (default) 1 = true

variables.name: Auto Update
variables.description: Pull the latest files on startup when using a GitHub repo.

variables.name: Binary Name
variables.description: The name of the binary to run (matches Cargo.toml name).

variables.name: Release Build
variables.description: Build in release mode (1) or debug mode (0). Release is slower to build but faster to run.

variables.name: Cargo Args
variables.description: Additional arguments for cargo build (e.g. --features my_feature)

variables.name: App Args
variables.description: Arguments to pass to the binary at runtime

variables.name: Git Access Token
variables.description: Password to use with git. It's best practice to use a Personal Access Token.
